usedFor: Mollie processes the payments, and Google Drive creates a file link for the buyer through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Payment” in Mollie, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new payment is when a buyer expects their file, and the action makes the link.

watchOut: “New Payment” in Mollie is polling, so the file link is created after a scheduled check.
